baseline: Reproduced authors released57bus DC case with supplied2019inputs

definitions.error: predicted - observed; positive bias is numerical overprediction in the declared orientation
definitions.error_SD_MW: population standard deviation of error, ddof=0
definitions.p95_AE_MW: 95th percentile absolute hourly error, linear quantile; not a confidence bound
definitions.nRMSE_percent: 100*RMSE/mean(abs(observed)); not normalized by range or standard deviation
definitions.MAPE_abs_actual_ge100_percent: Same MAPE restricted to abs(observed)>=100MW, a fixed disclosed diagnostic threshold
definitions.macro_equal_interface: Arithmetic mean of the seven interface-specific metrics; each interface has equal weight
definitions.macro_quantiles: Mean of seven interface-specific quantiles; not the quantile of pooled errors
definitions.pooled_interface_hours: Metrics recomputed on all interface-hour observations; overlapping gates mean this is not statewide energy accuracy
definitions.average_absolute_interface_bias_MW: mean across interfaces of abs(mean hourly error for that interface))
definitions.comparison_deltas: delta_*_pp columns are percentage-point differences. Other delta columns use the stated physical units. relative_change_*_percent is100*(2025/2019-1).

limitations: Cross-year descriptive comparison; load, generation, controls, topology, physics and cohorts differ.
2019 uses prepared local-hour observations;2025 uses qualified physicalUTC hours. No harmonized same-input replay is claimed.
Physical P32 meter equivalence and unchanged interface definitions across years are not certified.
These metrics are recomputed from released outputs, not quoted from the paper, which used a different limit-normalized metric.
MAPE near zero can dominate an average. Coverage and a fixed100MW sensitivity are exported; WAPE is the primary relative-error summary.
Signed mean bias can cancel across hours and interfaces. Average absolute interface bias is provided separately.
Percentile errors describe tails; no independence assumption or statistical-significance claim is made.
Interface comparisons overlap electrically; pooled aggregates are descriptive benchmark statistics, not systemwide energy errors.
